title: Venue collision
description: Authored collision volumes for one venue, in VENUE-LOCAL space. The client composes the venue's origin and Y rotation from content/town/*.json, exactly as it does for the mesh, so collision can never drift from geometry by a transform. Build Directive section 6 rule 4: deriving collision from a venue's bounding box is banned.

venue.description: Venue id; matches assets/meshes/<venue>.gltf and the town's venues[].id.

cells.description: 16 m grid cells the venue occupies (ARCHITECTURE section 3).

space.description: Reserved. World-space collision is not accepted: it would let a venue's collision and mesh be placed differently.

volumes.description: Convex, Y-extruded volumes. Empty is legal but means 'this venue is genuinely walk-through' and is reported by validate.py.

tag.description: Authoring label (wall, plinth, road, prop). Not gameplay state.

kind.description: solid blocks movement. surface only offers a standing height: roads, plazas and yard floors are raised walkable ground, never walls.

rotY.description: Radians about +Y. x' = cos*x + sin*z, z' = -sin*x + cos*z — the same convention as Mesh.rotate_y and three.js rotation.y.

center.description: Centre of the VOLUME, not the base — same convention as box.

points.description: Convex ring in XZ, counter-clockwise, extruded between minY and maxY.
